role: Ghatotkacha's son, Bhima's grandson; boasted he could end the war in one muhurta; his head watched the war; worshipped as Khatu Shyam
look: Young warrior-prince; deep brown skin; long black hair under a tall gold crown (Khatu Shyam's shrine iconography is crowned); gold earrings, armlets and necklace; saffron sash; Shyam-blue dhoti; longbow; quiver with exactly three blue-fletched arrows.
sourceNotes: Named for his hair 'like that of a Barbara' (Skanda Purana, Kaumarika Khanda 60.62-68). Three arrows are from the Khatu folk tradition. Everything else is a design choice. Worshipped today: keep him noble and gentle. The crown replaces the earlier topknot: his 'Barbara-like' hair now shows only as long hair under it.
notes: Detailed rig derived (2026-11-15) from the S01E01 rigs pandu/drawing-bow and king/folded-hands by episodes/X001-barbarika-three-arrows/svg/derive-cast.py: recoloured by body part, moustache hidden, quiver added. Keeps the source joint groups and data-pivot attributes. The first hand-drawn version is in episodes/X001-barbarika-three-arrows/svg/review/v1-characters/.
